August fiscal year-end · FY2026 has ended
Source: Bloomberg Desktop API, BEST_CAPEX; fixed FY2026 / FY2027 / FY2028; USD currency override.
Retrieved 29 Oct 2026. Annual consolidated capex; Samsung includes non-memory businesses. USD history includes FX.
Micron uses fiscal years ending in August, not calendar years. FY2026 is a completed period for Micron.
Lines connect available historical observations; dashed tails connect the last historical point to the current Bloomberg snapshot.
